textbookText: 6. What is meant by anti-pyretic property?
Ans:- The property of a substance that helps to reduce fever is called anti-pyretic property.
7. Write the name of vitamins found in aloevera.
Ans:- Aloe vera contains Vitamin A, Vitamin C, and Vitamin E.
8. Write the main reasons for climate change.
Ans:- The main reasons for climate change are deforestation, industrialization, burning of fossil fuels, and excessive emission
of greenhouse gases.
9. What types of animals are called rare animals?
Ans:- Animals whose population is very small and found only in limited areas are called rare animals.
10. Neem is a multipurpose medicinal plant. Why?
Ans:- Neem is called a multipurpose medicinal plant because its leaves, bark, seeds, and oil have antimicrobial, anti-
inflammatory, antiseptic, and insecticidal properties, and are used to treat many diseases and skin problems.
Section 'C'
Short answer type questions.
1. The main cause of climate change is air pollution. Justify this statement.
Ans:- Air pollution releases greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide and methane into the atmosphere, which trap heat and
increase Earth’s temperature, leading to climate change.
2. Write two main causes of climate change in Nepal.
Ans:- two main causes of climate change in Nepal are
i) Deforestation
ii) Industrialization and emission of greenhouse gases
3. How does climate change causes increase in sea level?
Ans:- Due to global warming, glaciers and polar ice melt, and the volume of seawater expands, which increases the sea level.
4. Write down any two applications of Asiatic pennywort.
Ans:- Any two applications of Asiatic pennywort are
i) It improves memory and brain function.
ii) It is used to heal wounds and skin diseases.

8. Climate change also causes the extinction of animals. Why?
Ans:- Climate change also causes the extinction of animals because it destroys natural habitats, changes food availability, and
disturbs breeding conditions of animals.
9. Endangered animals can be protected by conserving their natural habitat, why?
Ans:- Endangered animals can be protected by conserving their natural habitat Conserving natural habitats provides animals
with food, shelter, and safe breeding conditions, helping them survive and increase in number.
10. Holy basil is called a life-giving plant. Why?
Ans:- Holy basil is called a life-giving plant because it has medicinal properties that cure cough, cold, fever, and improve
immunity, thus promoting good health.
